home.heroTitle: Learn what matters, at your own pace.
home.heroSubtitle: Thousands of online and offline courses from expert tutors. Pick a path, build a habit, earn a certificate.
home.categoriesDesc: A few of our most popular fields. Each one branches into hundreds of courses.
home.featuredDesc: A curated mix of free starters and deep-dives across the most popular topics.
home.howItWorksTitle: From sign-up to certificate in three steps
home.step1Desc: Browse the catalog by category, mode (online or offline), price and rating.
home.step2Desc: Free courses start instantly. Paid and offline cohorts go through a quick checkout.
home.step3Desc: Progress is saved automatically. Finish the course to unlock your certificate.
home.whyUsTitle: Built for the way you actually learn
home.whyUsDesc: Bite-sized lessons, real practice, and a path that adapts to your level — online or in the classroom.
home.feature1Desc: Stream lessons online with progress that auto-saves and syncs across devices.
home.feature2Desc: Join in-person classes with limited seats, real schedules, and dedicated rooms.
home.feature3Desc: Complete a course and receive a verifiable certificate of completion.
home.tutorsTitle: Learn from people who do the work
home.tutorsDesc: Specialists from the Azerbaijan Technical University faculty and industry.
home.testimonial1Text: The mix of online videos and weekend offline classes was perfect for my schedule.
home.testimonial2Text: Tutors actually reply to questions. That changes everything when you're stuck.
home.testimonial3Text: I finished my first course in two weeks. The progress tracker kept me honest.
home.faqDesc: Can't find the answer you need? Reach out to the AZTU team and we'll get back to you.
home.faq1Q: How are AZTU EduPlatform courses different from regular videos?
home.faq1A: Every course has structured modules and lessons, tracks your progress automatically, supports notes, and gives you a verifiable certificate when complete. Offline courses also include schedules and assigned rooms.
home.faq2Q: Do I need to pay to start?
home.faq2A: Many starter courses are free. Paid courses go through a quick checkout. Offline cohorts may require approval from the tutor before your seat is confirmed.
home.faq3Q: Can I switch between online and offline?
home.faq3A: Each course is set up either as online or offline by the tutor. You can enroll in any number of either kind at the same time.
home.faq4Q: Will my progress be saved if I switch devices?
home.faq4A: Yes — progress is saved on the server. Sign in on another device and pick up exactly where you left off.
home.faq5Q: Is the platform available in Azerbaijani?
home.faq5A: Yes. Switch between English and Azərbaycan from the language selector in the top-right corner.
home.ctaTitle: Start learning at AZTU EduPlatform today
home.ctaDesc: Create a free account and enroll in your first course in minutes.
